metadata.title: Ensemble Grid with Central Oval Branding

retrievalProfile.description: A 3x4 grid layout featuring individual headshots surrounding a central 2x2 square dedicated to branding and titles.
triggerTerms: grid of portraits with center logo
excludeWhen: asymmetric or organic layouts are preferred
minimalist designs with high negative space

recipe.visualDefinition: A structured composite consisting of ten individual portrait squares arranged in a perimeter around a central double-width, double-height square. The central area contains a prominent blue oval logo with glowing script and secondary sans-serif and script typography below it.
coreVisualRelationships: Uniform square framing for all subjects
Diverse lighting and backgrounds within individual portraits

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Ten subjects occupy the outer squares of the grid at equal scale, shown in medium close-up headshots.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central blue oval logo serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central logo and moves clockwise around the perimeter to view individual subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the grid is fully packed with imagery and text blocks.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central logo area contrasts with the varied naturalistic tones of the surrounding photography.
paletteRestrictions: Central block must use a contrasting solid background color

letterConstructionRules: Main title in a fluid, slanted cursive script with a neon glow effect
Secondary title in a casual, upright brush script
Tertiary title in a bold, wide, all-caps sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script letters feature extended swashes and internal glows
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for brand identity paired with a heavy sans-serif for impact and clarity.

avoid: Overlapping the perimeter photos with the central text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual, energetic feel of the secondary script.
Provides the necessary weight for the bottom display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3x4 grid of diverse individual portraits. The central 2x2 area should be a solid pale cream color. Each portrait should be a medium close-up with varied backgrounds.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large blue oval with a double white/cyan border in the center of the cream square. Inside the oval, add a glowing white script title. Below the oval, add a secondary script line and a final line of bold, wide, dark blue sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the grid exactly 3 columns by 4 rows?
Is the central 2x2 area clear of portraits?
Does the central logo have a distinct neon-like glow?
Are the perimeter subjects all framed as headshots?

mustRedesign: Specific faces of the original cast
postGenerationChecks: Verify the central oval is perfectly centered within the 2x2 block.
Ensure the neon glow effect does not obscure the legibility of the script.
Check that all 10 perimeter squares contain unique subjects.
recipe.reuseFormula: Grid(3x4) + CenterBlock(2x2, Color:Cream) + Anchor(OvalLogo, Style:NeonScript) + Perimeter(Headshots)
